concerns.location: spec.md:User Story 3 - high-fiber (top [deferred], 75th percentile) and low-fiber (bottom [deferred], 25th percentile)
concerns.text: The specification defines high‑fiber as the top 75th percentile and low‑fiber as the bottom 25th percentile, whereas the original idea explicitly states high‑fiber = top 25 % and low‑fiber = bottom 25 % (quartiles). This silent redefinition changes the research question and will affect effect‑size estimates and replication criteria.

concerns.location: spec.md:Edge Cases – “What if one dataset has significantly fewer samples than the other? → The system MUST perform power analysis and report calculated power and margin of error.”
concerns.text: The idea does not request a formal power analysis; it only mentions a measurement‑error simulation. Adding a mandatory power‑analysis step introduces work beyond the scoped research question.

concerns.location: spec.md:Success Criteria – SC-004 “Computational feasibility is measured against the constraint of ≤6 hours runtime on a CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner.”
concerns.text: Runtime constraints were not part of the original idea. Introducing a hard 6‑hour limit adds an engineering requirement that was not requested and may unnecessarily restrict implementation choices.
